name: Comp and discount watch
summary: Reads each venue's paid sales from Square, checks every discount on them, and flags comps and discounts outside the agreed terms, with a daily count per venue. The crons only read and record; nothing in Square is changed.

covered_by.trigger-event: watch (each new paid sale and its discounts read from Square)
covered_by.exception-check: watch (flags a discount not on the allowed list, or a percentage over the threshold, including 100 percent comps)
covered_by.reporting: report (yesterday's sales, discounted sales, flagged sales and discount dollars per venue)

crons.name: watch
crons.summary: Reads each venue's new paid sales and their discounts from Square, and flags comps and discounts that fall outside the settings.

crons.name: report
crons.summary: Counts yesterday's sales, discounts and flags per venue (22:00 UTC is 8 or 9 am in eastern Australia).

draft_ops_note: Both draft operations are GET reads. The watch cron writes sale and flag records to the workflow store only. The report cron reads the store and makes no call.

square.covers: each venue's paid sales and the discounts on each sale, both reads

gaps: Roller is not in the kit: no adapter, so its till and discount steps are not covered.
Lightspeed and BePoz: their help pages name no comp or discount step, and neither has a platform folder in the kit, so no adapter is built.
Square's docs do not use the words comp or void. The watch treats a comp as a discount of 100 percent. Confirm the business's own term in a live account.

Square's SearchOrders is a POST, which the kit classes as a write, so it is not used. Sales are read as a payments list followed by one RetrieveOrder call per sale. Reading it as a read would need a kit change, which this build does not make.

A Square discount has no field for the reason it was given or the staff member who applied it. A flag shows what was applied, not why. The record keeps the payment's team member, which may not be the person who applied the discount. Confirm in a live account.
No live operation: changing or voiding a discount on a finished sale is a person step in Square. No mapped Square operation is queued here.
Approving a comp before it is given, Square's discount passcode, staff meals, stock and waste, and shift review are not built.
The first run looks back 24 hours; older sales are not checked.
Square's platform record reads spec and offline only, and the adapter is docs-only until a Square sandbox account proves it.
